description: Query the wiki and render the answer as portable, GitHub-flavored markdown saved under vault/output/. Trigger when the user asks to "export X as markdown", "produce a markdown brief", "save the answer to the output folder", "give me a plain markdown version of …", or invokes /claude-wiki-pages:markdown directly. Reuses the query reading contract, then strips Obsidian-only syntax so the file is usable outside the vault.
